headline: Sylvan Esso think you should splurge on good-quality yogurt
summary: Electro-pop duo Sylvan Esso discusses their music and life perspective. They advocate for investing in high-quality yogurt. The band has released multiple acclaimed records since 2014.

headline: Anthropic CEO says it's time to pump the brakes on AI
summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei calls for a slowdown in AI development. He proposes a three-step plan to 'pace the frontier' of AI. Third-party evaluators like METR will access models for safety adherence.

headline: LG responds to TV spying allegations
summary: LG is defending itself against recent accusations of its smart TVs collecting user data. Security researchers had detailed alarming data logging findings. LG claims media coverage created 'misconceptions' about their TV operations.

headline: Trump is giving data centers a pass to pollute
summary: Former EPA officials report President Trump is weakening environmental rules for AI data centers. This move accelerates construction but raises health risks for Americans. They urge the adoption of a 'Data Center Health Protection' plan.

headline: Level-5 Boss Addresses AI Backlash After Game Reveal Showcase
summary: Developer Level-5 apologized for using generative AI in recent game footage. Fans spotted 'AI slop' in titles like Professor Layton and DecaPolice. The studio addressed the backlash after its game reveal showcase.

headline: BlizzCon 2026 Opening Ceremony Live Blog: Warcraft, Diablo & StarCraft News Expected
summary: IGN is live blogging the BlizzCon 2026 opening ceremony. Big announcements are expected for World of Warcraft and Diablo. Strong rumors also hint at a new StarCraft reveal.

headline: The Magic of Disney Animation: Walt Disney World's Updates Are Working
summary: An early look at 'The Magic of Disney Animation' received positive feedback. The attraction proves Walt Disney World's mission of thoughtfully updating historical experiences. The park's renovation efforts are demonstrating success.

headline: Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World Preview: 500 Weird Beasts
summary: 'Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World' promises 500 unique creatures to collect. The game is shaping up as a charming entry in the monster-collecting RPG genre. Its distinct charm and wholesomeness set it apart in a crowded market.

headline: Reform receives second £36m donation in two days
summary: The Reform party has secured a second £36 million donation in two days. A crypto investor matched a previous record-breaking contribution. Rival parties are renewing calls for individual political donation caps.

headline: Burnham and Badenoch revive red versus blue politics
summary: Labour and Conservatives are rediscovering traditional political divides. This comes as Reform experiences 'gobsmacking' donations despite slipping polls. Laura Kuenssberg analyzes the shift back to familiar political dynamics.

headline: Trump says united Ireland would be 'fantastic' in Dublin visit
summary: Donald Trump stated a united Ireland would be 'fantastic' during his Dublin visit. He made the comments during a meeting with Irish leader Micheál Martin. Downing Street affirmed it would 'stick to the Good Friday Agreement'.

headline: Anthropic boss Dario Amodei calls for AI development to slow down
summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei urges a slowdown in AI development. His call stems from increasing worries about AI models causing global damage. Concerns grow that advanced AI could inflict serious worldwide harm.
